description.subtitle: Chelsea Nike Drawstring Backpack - Blue
description.tagline: Represent Chelsea in comfort and style
description.intro: The Nike Chelsea Academy drawstring backpack is the perfect option to transport your equipment lightly on a daily basis. Inspired by the London club, it combines a sporty design with the practicality you need for your training or travel.
key_benefits: Lightweight design: Perfect for carrying essentials without adding extra weight.
Quick access: Lace-up closure system that makes it easy to open and close in seconds.
Official Chelsea style: Show your passion for the Blues at every training session.
Versatile use: Ideal for gym, workouts or everyday use.
